title: Dual-Interrelated Diffusion Model for Few-Shot Anomaly Image Generation (DualAnoDiff)
mechanism: Two interrelated diffusion models generate the whole image and the anomaly part together, so the mask follows the generated defect; background and shape information reduce blur.
adaptation: Same role as AnomalyDiffusion for blobby classes and as a benchmark baseline; only if code is public.
min_experiment: Arm: PF + DualAnoDiff inactive samples. Baseline: row 2 arm. Metric: CV inactive IoU. Kill: not better than row 2; skip unless code exists by 20 Nov.
evidence: R: better diversity, realism and mask accuracy than prior methods on MVTec and better downstream detection, localization, classification (abstract).
